svg.title: Bern fold 0 assignments
svg.desc: Actual saved b5 fold 0, 65 columns by 35 rows: 1,149 training, 450 validation, 475 test, 201 unused buffer tiles. Each tile is 135.5 metres wide. Blocks are 5 by 5 tiles, 677.5 metres per side. Only training tiles touching test, including diagonals, are buffered. Validation is not buffered.

g.text: 65 × 35 tile cells · 5 × 5-tile blocks · saved split, not a schematic
North ↑ · West at left · tile IDs increase east, then south
Buffer: training tiles within one tile of TEST only, including diagonals.
Validation = next fold; validation can touch test. Buffer is never used.
Source: eval/splits/b5_fold0.csv · counts precede scoring masks/exclusions · within-city evaluation
